label: Mason in his studio — watercolor story
content: Mason (the person from the character reference) standing in his cluttered artist studio among homemade contraptions of pipes and funnels, arms crossed, pleased with himself. Nobody else in the scene.

label: Mason operating the noise-art pipeline — watercolor story
content: Mason (the person from the character reference) operating his noise-art pipeline: he holds a long pipe with a moppy net head full of small colored dots feeding in; the pipe runs through a wider accordion squeegee section and a moppy section, snaking up and around, and finally empties onto a small framed picture hung high on a gallery wall. Nobody else in the scene.

label: Mason hanging his art in the gallery — watercolor story
content: Mason (the person from the character reference) up on a small stepladder, hanging a small framed abstract picture of colored dots high on a white gallery wall. Nobody else in the scene.
